name: nuxt-nest-learning-project

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/frontend && npm run build --workspace apps/backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/frontend && npm run lint --workspace apps/backend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/backend && npm run test --workspace apps/frontend
scripts.test:ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.verify: npm run test:ci && npm run test:e2e

description: Learning project with Nuxt frontend, Nest backend, queue/search/cache, and cloud-ready DevOps setup.
